title: Stations+
description: Station+ is a Minecraft mod that introduces a variety of functional workstations, each with a unique role in crafting items that are otherwise impossible, impractical, or unavailable in vanilla gameplay.
body:
![Stations+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/168d6156dbaa4dc0f761a0e94e0a4bea20eaf0a7.png)**Station+** is a Minecraft mod that introduces a variety of functional workstations, each with a unique role in crafting items that are otherwise impossible, impractical, or unavailable in vanilla gameplay. Instead of expanding the base crafting system through traditional tables, this mod gives each recipe group its own identity, mechanics, and purpose — bringing more immersion and progression to your Minecraft world.

Here are the stations currently available in the mod:

🔬 **Infusion Table**
Used for crafting custom spawn eggs. By combining mob genes (which can be obtained from specific mobs) with regular chicken eggs, players can create any spawn egg they want. This system simulates a basic form of genetic engineering and gives players full control over what mobs they want to summon — even without using commands or creative mode.

🐴 **Equine Table**
Dedicated to horse-related equipment. With this station, players can craft horse armor, saddles, and name tags — all items that are either non-craftable or rare in vanilla Minecraft. It's an essential addition for those who love exploring on horseback or want full control over mount equipment.

**_You can obtain leather by smelting rotten flesh in a furnace._**

🕸 **Spawner Table**
Allows crafting of empty mob spawners. Once an empty spawner is created (through a costly but balanced recipe), it can be customized by inserting a spawn egg made via the Infusion Table. This enables players to build their own mob farms or custom dungeons, giving survival gameplay a new layer of control and challenge.

💀 **Totem Table**
This table is used to craft the Totem of Undying, a powerful item usually only dropped by evokers.


Each station is thoughtfully designed with a fitting GUI, a balanced crafting recipe, and visual theming that reflects its function. Future versions of the mod may add even more unique tables and expand on the existing mechanics.<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/AW8K3GFZC1o" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
